title: Forge Conductor executable skeleton contract
author: harness-architect
non_claims: No service, daemon, systemd unit, container, HTTP listener or migration was created.
No production database, table, role or file was changed; the scratch database forge_scratch was created and dropped inside this task.
No Craft CLI was executed and no artifact was verified; the executor boundary is a test double.
The guard labels in forge_transition are documentation; the database enforces topology and verdict rules, not semantic guard truth.
Nothing here proves design quality, learning, retrieval lift or cost; those remain open gaps and later tasks.

environment.scratch_database: forge_scratch (created and dropped; production pod database never connected)

evidence_labels.RUN: executed in this task, output in the design doc section 10
evidence_labels.READ: read from the repo with path
evidence_labels.DESIGN: carried from wave2/04 as an unexecuted statement

executable_artifacts.name: forge_schema.sql
executable_artifacts.proof: applied twice to PostgreSQL 16.15 scratch DB (exit 0 both times); 18 assertions pass; 2-worker SKIP LOCKED claim does not block

executable_artifacts.name: check.ts
executable_artifacts.proof: positive compile exit 0; removing a required field yields TS2741 exit 2

tables.name: forge_transition
tables.purpose: reference data: legal episode edges plus guard labels
key_constraints: CHECK both states in the 15-state set

tables.name: forge_episode
tables.purpose: one episode one row with status/verdict/budget/plan
key_constraints: CHECK accepted implies verdict pass or pass_with_notes

tables.name: forge_event
key_constraints: BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE trigger raises 42501

tables.name: forge_handoff
tables.purpose: typed specialist handoffs claimed with a lease

tables.name: forge_artifact
tables.purpose: artifact index backed by a content-addressed store

tables.name: forge_gate
tables.purpose: domain gate evidence per artifact hash

tables.name: forge_critique
tables.purpose: blind critic evidence with crop-cited dimensions

tables.name: forge_eval
tables.purpose: one evaluation per episode per arm

tables.name: forge_job
tables.purpose: Postgres queue with SKIP LOCKED leases and dedupe

tables.name: forge_skill
key_constraints: one active per skill_id via partial unique index

tables.name: forge_budget_ledger
tables.purpose: daily token and cost accumulation with hard cap
key_constraints: charge raises E_BUDGET_EXCEEDED and rolls back over cap

tables.name: forge_approval
tables.purpose: single-use human approval bound to artifact hash and scope
key_constraints: consume updates only unused unexpired rows

sql_functions.name: forge_can_transition
sql_functions.signature: forge_can_transition(p_from text, p_to text) returns boolean

sql_functions.name: forge_transition_episode
sql_functions.signature: forge_transition_episode(p_episode uuid, p_to text, p_verdict text default null, p_reason text[] default '{}') returns forge_episode
sql_functions.purpose: guarded transition; refuses illegal edges, enforces accepted verdict, sets finished_at, appends an episode.transition event

sql_functions.name: forge_append_event
sql_functions.signature: forge_append_event(p_episode uuid, p_kind text, p_payload jsonb) returns forge_event

sql_functions.name: forge_verify_event_chain
sql_functions.signature: forge_verify_event_chain(p_episode uuid) returns table(checked integer, broken integer)

sql_functions.name: forge_claim_handoff
sql_functions.signature: forge_claim_handoff(p_role text, p_lease_s integer default 900) returns forge_handoff
sql_functions.purpose: SKIP LOCKED claim; NULL when nothing ready

sql_functions.name: forge_replay_tool_call
sql_functions.purpose: return the stored result for an idempotency key

sql_functions.name: forge_claim_job
sql_functions.signature: forge_claim_job(p_worker text, p_lease_s integer default 300) returns forge_job
sql_functions.purpose: SKIP LOCKED job claim with lease and attempt increment

sql_functions.name: forge_finish_job
sql_functions.signature: forge_finish_job(p_job bigint, p_ok boolean, p_error text default null) returns forge_job
sql_functions.purpose: finish only from claimed/running, else E_JOB_STATE

sql_functions.name: forge_charge
sql_functions.signature: forge_charge(p_account bigint, p_day date, p_tokens_in bigint, p_tokens_out bigint, p_cents numeric, p_cap_cents numeric default null) returns forge_budget_ledger
sql_functions.purpose: upsert usage; raise E_BUDGET_EXCEEDED over cap

sql_functions.name: forge_consume_approval
sql_functions.signature: forge_consume_approval(p_episode uuid, p_sha text, p_scope text) returns forge_approval

sql_functions.name: forge_immutability_report
sql_functions.signature: forge_immutability_report() returns table(table_name text, has_trigger boolean)

enforced: terminal states have no outgoing edges
not_enforced: semantic guard labels such as retrieval_receipt or locks_budget (conductor responsibility; gap G-03)
state_machine.correction: wave2/04 allowed quarantined->cancelled; the executable test rejected that as contradicting terminal semantics, so the edge was removed (37->36) and quarantined is terminal

python_public.name: idempotency_key
python_public.signature: idempotency_key(episode_id: str, tool_id: str, params: dict, input_hashes: Sequence[str] = ()) -> str
python_public.purpose: sha256-prefixed stable key with schema tag forge-idem/1

python_public.name: may_retry
python_public.signature: may_retry(code: str, attempt: int, max_attempts: int) -> bool

python_public.name: Gateway.execute
python_public.purpose: ordered checks, replay, execute, classify, store

protocols.name: Executor
protocols.purpose: real CLI adapter (task-08) or test double

protocols.name: Repo
protocols.signature: find(key: str) -> ToolResult | None; store(key: str, result: ToolResult) -> None
protocols.purpose: forge_tool_call table in production, in-memory in tests

idempotency.key_formula: sha256(canonical_json({episode_id, tool_id, params, input_hashes, schema: forge-idem/1})) prefixed with sha256:
idempotency.canonicalisation: sorted keys, compact separators, UTF-8, NaN/Infinity rejected

guarantees.property: same logical call yields same key
at most one execution per key
publish/promotion cannot be replayed for free

idempotency.known_race: find-then-insert is not atomic; the DB unique index is the real guard and a production Repo must catch unique_violation and re-read (gap G-01)

concurrency.scenario: worker A claims a job and sleeps 3s while worker B claims

negative.mutation: remove runner_version from the GateReport literal

evidence.observed: T01 PASS tables=13 edges=36 ... T18 PASS; ALL SQL ASSERTIONS PASSED; exit=0

evidence.command: two psql sessions, one holding a claim with pg_sleep(3)
